title: MD-B03 closure evaluation: coverage validated, both exit criteria proven, closure blocked by an absent record
attempt_outcome: PARTIAL_BLOCKED — every technical closure criterion is met; MD-B03 cannot reach DONE because MD-B03-A001 has no Change Impact Declaration

runtime_artifact_boundary.classification: Executed database proof plus source and document proof.
runtime_artifact_boundary.basis: The clean-install and reason-registry criteria are runtime proof and were executed against MariaDB 10.4.27 on an isolated database created and dropped by this attempt. No storage/** artifact was required, produced, or claimed.

coverage_claim_validated.why_it_needed_validating: MD-DEP-0004 makes ownership validation a per-stage entry obligation and MD-B03 had never performed it. STAGE_CLOSURE_MANIFEST_STANDARD.md forbids claiming DONE from a percentage computed over a provisional denominator, and an unchecked 0/0 is provisional.
coverage_claim_validated.method: Checked from both directions. First, the matrix was searched for rules whose subject is an MD-B03 deliverable — migration, additive schema, repository interface, reason registry, test harness. Ten rules matched the words; every one belongs to another stage and mentions migration only as a prohibition qualifier, for example MD-S007-R0033 forbidding a migration from updating sealed snapshot content. None is an MD-B03 predicate. Second, and decisively, the build sequence was read as the authority for what the stage must deliver.
coverage_claim_validated.result: MD-B03's acceptance criteria are not traceability rows. MD_IMPLEMENTATION_BUILD_SEQUENCE.md states its frozen exit intent as an enabling condition: `clean-install/upgrade path tersedia untuk setiap feature berikut; belum ada nullable placeholder yang dianggap conformant`. MD-B03 builds the skeleton later stages fill; the strategy contracts describe the filled artifacts. 0/0 is correct, and is now validated rather than assumed.
coverage_claim_validated.note_on_method: A word search alone would have been the weak-pattern trap this stage has recorded before. It was used to find candidates, not to conclude; the build sequence settled it.

exit_criterion_2_nullable_placeholder.criterion: belum ada nullable placeholder yang dianggap conformant
exit_criterion_2_nullable_placeholder.gap_found: No test in the repository proved this half. MigrationIntegrityAndDriftTest quotes the exit gate in its own docblock and proved only the clean-install half; the word `nullable` appeared exactly once in the file, inside that quotation, for the whole epoch. This is the shape section 26 of the execution contract names: a gate whose PASS does not test the invariant it claims.
exit_criterion_2_nullable_placeholder.owner_contract: db/DB_Schema_And_Migration_Sync_Contract_LOCKED.md, which states the invariant exactly — nullable rollout columns `are not a weaker accepted production state; a later enforcement migration is required after verified backfill`, and backfill and enforcement must be `distinct observable stages when nullability is needed for rollout`.
guards_added: test_the_rollout_matrix_and_the_deployed_schema_agree_that_no_area_is_relocked — parses the nine-area V2 rollout matrix and requires every area to read `open` while the foundation columns are still nullable; a relocked area whose columns were never enforced fails here

test_no_rollout_column_is_enforced_not_null_before_a_verified_backfill — no later migration may make any of the 69 distinct V2 rollout columns NOT NULL while the matrix reports no verified backfill for any area

test_the_nullable_foundation_is_still_recorded_as_progress_not_closure — the contract's three statements and the dictionary's `implementation progress, not closure` must remain present, because an affirmative rule is not proven by silence
test_the_nullable_placeholder_detectors_can_fire — both enforcement probes must match a violation and stay silent on an ordinary nullable declaration
exit_criterion_2_nullable_placeholder.scope_discipline: A coarse detector — any migration containing both a NOT NULL and a data write — flagged eight files that create ordinary new columns with defaults. That is not the defect the contract describes, and shipping it would have been a false-positive guard of the kind MD-S020-R0172 forbids. The guard targets the V2 rollout columns specifically, which is what the contract's `nullability needed for rollout` actually means.
exit_criterion_2_nullable_placeholder.what_was_deliberately_not_done: The nullable columns were not enforced. The contract requires a verified backfill first, and this attempt performed none. Enforcing them to make the gate look satisfied would have been the exact defect the exit criterion exists to prevent.
exit_criterion_2_nullable_placeholder.verdict: PROVEN, by a guard that did not exist before this attempt

closure_evaluation.verdict: MD-B03 does not close. CHANGE_IMPACT_DECLARATION_STANDARD.md section 3 states that for a material attempt a missing declaration blocks DONE even if tests and other gates pass. Every other criterion is met.
closure_evaluation.why_the_missing_record_was_not_written: Section 3 requires the declaration to exist early enough to guide the attempt's validation scope, and section 13 of the execution contract forbids repairing a historical timing deviation by writing the record late or editing issued evidence. Producing CI-MD-B03-A001-001 today would satisfy section 1 by falsifying section 3.
